introductions.canonical: You are the governor of {region} in Contagion.
introductions.numbered: Your role: governor. Your region: {region}. Game: Contagion.
introductions.questions: Which region do you govern? {region}. Which game are you playing? Contagion.
introductions.reordered: Contagion puts you in charge of {region} as its governor.
introductions.heldout-briefing: Take the role of governor responsible for {region} in Contagion.

rules.canonical: Six governors set lockdown 0..4, testing 0..3, and three road gates 0..2 simultaneously each week. You may send up to 200 credits of aid and a short public message. True infection counts are hidden; reported cases reflect each region's published testing. Maximize your own ledger minus twice your deaths. Reply with one JSON action and no other text.
rules.plain: Each week, six governors choose at once: lockdown from 0 to 4, testing from 0 to 3, and a gate from 0 to 2 on each of three roads. You can also send up to 200 credits in aid and a short public message. Infection totals are hidden; reported cases depend on each region's published testing. Aim for the highest own ledger minus twice your deaths. Return one JSON action with no additional text.
rules.numbered:
Weekly briefing:
1. Six governors choose simultaneously.
2. Set lockdown 0..4, testing 0..3, and each of three road gates 0..2.
3. You may send up to 200 credits of aid and a short public message.
4. True infection counts are hidden. Reported cases reflect each region's published testing.
5. Maximize your own ledger minus twice your deaths.
6. Return one JSON action and no other text.
